page.layout: Two round coin medallions with legends across the top, side by side (left: Scribonia, right: Livia Drusilla), both illustrations. Below them, one column of running text in two paragraphs. Below the text, the gathering signature. At the foot of the page, a decorative woodcut ornament (no text).

main_text.l: SCRIBONIA AVGVSTI VXOR
LIVIA DRVSILLA AVGVSTI VXOR
SCRIBONIA Imperatoris Augusti vxor fuit, postquàm
ille dimisisset supradictâ Claudiam, quæ illi in matrimonium
pacta fuerat, sicuti diximus. Porrò Scribonia hæc nupserat ante
duobus Consularibus, & ex altero quoque mater fuerat: cum
hac etiâ diuortium fecit Augustus, pertæsus (vt scripsit) morum
eius peruersitatem: ex hac filiam Iuliam suscepit. Vide C. Sue-
tonium Tranquillum in vita Octauij Augusti, Romanorum
imperatoris secundi.
LIVIA Drusilla vxor quoque fuit Augusti, quam matri-
monio Tiberij Neronis, Imperatoris Tiberij patris, & quidem
prægnantem abduxit, dilexitque ac probauit vnice ac perseue-
ranter. Ex hac nullos suscepit liberos, cùm maximè cuperet: in-
fans (is est Drusus Tiberij Imperatoris frater, ac Claudij Cæsa-
ris, qui Tiberio successit, pater) qui conceptus erat, immaturus
est editus. in oculis Liuiæ, & in hac voce defecit Augustus:
Liuia, nostri coniugij memor viue, ac vale: fortitus exitum facilem,
& qualem semper optauerat. Vide Suetonium Tranquillum in
Octauio Augusto, & secudi libri huius operis paginâ quintam.

page.notes: The two coin medallions are illustrations (portrait profiles of Scribonia and Livia Drusilla); their circular legends are transcribed above as lines. The woodcut ornament at the foot of the page is an illustration with no text. "Mm 4" is the gathering signature. "secudi" is printed that way. The italic sentence "Liuia, nostri coniugij memor viue, ac vale:" is set in italic in the original.
